# Put logic in the module that owns it

Implement behaviour in the component responsible for it — specifier parsing in the resolver, custom-resolver behaviour on the resolver — keep unrelated settings out of `authConfig`, and move single-use helpers next to their only caller.

**Why:** Requested on 4 PRs by 2 reviewers.

## Examples from PR review history

- > I don't think the current implementation is good because the parsing of the `bareSpecifier` should be the resolver's duty.

- > I also agree it feels most correct for this to be a property of the custom resolver that needs to be implemented.
